To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
nutrient restriction during proliferation or differentiation had an effect on satellite cell activity that varied depending on age, growth rate, and the duration and timing of nutrient restriction.

the response of satellite cell proliferation and differentiation to nutrient restriction is dependent on the age of the bird and the timing of nutrient restriction during proliferation or differentiation.

the effect of nutrient restriction during proliferation and differentiation of p. major satellite cells is dependent on age and growth rate of birds and the duration and timing of nutrient restriction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of nutrient restriction during the immediate post‐hatch period on the proliferation and/or differentiation of turkey satellite cells.
the effects of nutrition on muscle development.
the effects of nutrient restriction on turkey satellite cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the effect of nutrient restriction during satellite cell proliferation is dependent on the age of the bird, whereas the effect of nutrient during satellite cell differentiation is dependent on the timing and duration of nutrient restriction.

the proliferation and differentiation rates of satellite cells isolated from p. major muscle of turkey points are dependent upon age and growth rate, as well as nutrient restriction during proliferation and/or differentiation.
the response of satellite cell to nutrient restriction was not dependent on bird age or growth rate, but was dependent on the duration and timing of nutrient restriction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
satellite cell response to nutrition restriction is age and growth dependent.
the response of satellite cell activity to nutrient restriction depends on the duration, timing, and age of the cell.

satellite cells from 1‐d‐old birds are the most sensitive to nutrient restriction and are more sensitive during the differentiation stage of the satellite cell life cycle, whereas 16‐wk satellite cells are less sensitive to nutrient restriction.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the timing and duration of nutrient restriction is critical to satellite cell proliferation and differentiation, and this may be more important than the degree of nutrient restriction.
the response of satellite cell activity to nutrient restriction is age dependent.
the response to nutrient restriction of satellite cells from 1‐d‐old turkeys is different from that of older birds.
